en.title: E
en.summary: The letter E is the fifth letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter name
paragraphs: The letter name is spoken as the sound /e/, that is a full vowel e. Its main sound is heard in (elefant) /ˈe.le.fant/, which means elephant. This letter makes three different sounds in Romanian words.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, open your mouth halfway and spread your lips wide. Keep your tongue high and forward. For the second sound, begin with a quick glide before the main vowel. For the third sound, glide smoothly from this vowel toward the next vowel without stopping. Touch your throat to feel your voice buzz steadily.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In most words, this letter makes the sound /e/, that is a full vowel e, as in (elev) /eˈlev/. At the start of personal pronouns and forms of the verb to be, it makes the sound /je/, as in (el) /jel/. When it glides into another vowel, it makes the sound /e̯/, that is a gliding vowel e, as in (seară) /ˈse̯a.rə/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not turn the simple vowel into a glide like the vowel sound in day. Keep your tongue steady and pure from start to finish. In basic pronouns, do not drop the initial glide like the start of elbow. Make sure you add the quick glide heard at the beginning of yes.
